precedence: The actual recipient agreement selects the format, legal parties and transport.
Apply current Unite-specific rules to the original openTRANS1.0 document.
Use the captured original DTD and parameter-entity files for structure, order, cardinality and attributes.
Preserve complete original XML and all source comments/extensions; projection does not replace the source.

identity.rule: Complete exact reference, maximum21 Unicode characters; internal hyphens and special characters are allowed. Preserve the entire value.
Preserve the original order line identity. Dispatch/invoice own line numbers and ORDER_REFERENCE/LINE_ITEM_ID are distinct.
Retain the supplier account number and original type attribute in each related document.
Retain the original customer account number and party role. Regular and agency/C-Order sources have different buyer identities.
Original source hash plus business identity distinguishes immutable inputs. A repeated business document is an explicit revision selection; identical bytes are replay.

partyAndOrderModes.regular: Current order guidance identifies the relevant Unite entity as buyer for the ordinary Spotmarket/SingleCreditor order.
partyAndOrderModes.agency: Current C-Order guidance identifies the actual end customer as buyer for agency forwarding, Exclusive Catalogue or Business Shop.
partyAndOrderModes.invoiceParty: Order guidance says INVOICE_PARTY equals BUYER_PARTY. Retain actual original legal parties; the selected invoice recipient arrangement controls outgoing billing.
partyAndOrderModes.address: The three delivery NAME/NAME2/NAME3 lines each permit up to70 characters. Customer order/job information can occur in the third address line.
partyAndOrderModes.consolidation: Orders with different actual legal/invoice/delivery parties or currencies need an explicit compatible consolidation agreement; do not silently replace those parties.

ORDER.priceRule: Net line amount = PRICE_AMOUNT × QUANTITY ÷ PRICE_QUANTITY; omitted PRICE_QUANTITY has effective value1.

ORDERRESPONSE.availability: A receipt-only acknowledgment with no deliverability statement is not processed by Unite. Positive quantity may confirm less than ordered.
ORDERRESPONSE.cancellation: A negative quantity cancels its absolute amount: ordered3/-3 cancels all; ordered3/-2 cancels two. It does not establish availability of the remaining unit.
ORDERRESPONSE.revision: Unite permits a new confirmation for an updated date or other change. The selected latest explicit line confirmation replaces earlier confirmation effect; negative repeats never accumulate cancellation.
ORDERRESPONSE.sparseLinePolicy: The product retains a prior explicit line selection when that line is absent from a partial response. This is an explicit application interpretation; the current vendor text does not define field-by-field merge semantics.
ORDERRESPONSE.price: When ARTICLE_PRICE is omitted, the original ORDER price is confirmed, including after a previous response with a changed price.
ORDERRESPONSE.date: Header date applies unless the item provides its own date. Missing date alone is not declared a universal mandatory-field failure in the current table.

DISPATCHNOTIFICATION.dateMeaning: Document date is interpreted as shipping date if no separate shipping date is supplied.
DISPATCHNOTIFICATION.transport: Only TRANSPORT_PARTY/NAME is processed by the current Unite interface; preserve the whole original tree.
DISPATCHNOTIFICATION.packages: One PACKAGE_INFO per supplied package number. Item package data is optional and overrides the header when different; lack of tracking is not by itself a universal mandatory field.
DISPATCHNOTIFICATION.revision: Distinct supplier-scoped dispatch IDs contribute separate documented quantities; selecting a revision of the same ID replaces its previous complete contribution, including removed order references.

header.parties: Original buyer, supplier and invoice legal parties/VAT identifiers

INVOICE.summaryMeaning: TOTAL_AMOUNT is the complete invoice net amount, excluding tax and separately represented surcharges/deductions. TOTAL_TAX_AMOUNT is the tax total.
INVOICE.revision: Retain the original supplier/issuer identity alongside invoice number. A corrected same invoice number replaces only that issuer’s prior contribution.
INVOICE.financialMeaning: An invoice document and a documented dispatch do not establish cash settlement or physical receipt. Retain the actual transmission response and any separate recipient processing outcome.

deliveryDate.inheritance: Item value overrides the header; original type and both period endpoints remain retained.

money.typeAttribute: ARTICLE_PRICE/@type is required in the original specification; preserve the actual price type and its commercial meaning.
money.priceQuantity: Optional exact NUMBER; effective1 only when absent. Preserve native absence and explicit fractional values.
money.tax: Unite invoice TAX is a fractional rate, for example0.19. Retain original rate, any native tax amount and currency.
money.exact: Original NUMBER lexemes support signs, decimal points and exponent notation. Use exact rational arithmetic; retain original numeric strings.
money.currency: Compare and total money only under coherent original price/header currencies. Equal numeric ratios in different currencies are different prices.
money.rounding: Any target rounding selection records scale, mode and line-versus-document aggregation basis. Generation and review use the same basis; source values remain unchanged.
money.specificationCaution: The old PRICE_LINE_AMOUNT prose includes a self-reference. Current Unite’s specific PRICE_AMOUNT × QUANTITY ÷ PRICE_QUANTITY rule resolves the calculation. The original TAX_AMOUNT text is retained for interpretation with the actual invoice sample.

serials.rule: Preserve complete original REMARK text and original serial strings. Multiple serials use repeated fields, without joining them using commas or semicolons.

nativeXml.encoding: Honor the original XML encoding declaration. The standard explicitly permits UTF-8, UTF-16 and ISO-8859-1.
nativeXml.lengths: Declared field lengths count characters, not encoded bytes.
nativeXml.presence: Both mandatory and optional-present original elements contain meaningful content; empty/whitespace-only is invalid.
nativeXml.numbers: NUMBER, INTEGER and COUNT are separate native lexical types; COUNT is a nonnegative integer. Preserve original lexical values and validate the actual field type.
nativeXml.dtd: Resolve external declarations only to exact captured local DTD members and their selected parameter-entity dependencies. Do not fetch entities from the network.
nativeXml.preservation: Retain original element names, child order, attributes, text, comments, full source bytes and the selected DTD source.

reviewAndReceiving.immutableSource: Import complete original source even when business review finds inconsistent quantities/prices; retain actionable findings instead of losing the input.
reviewAndReceiving.currentEffect: Current projection records selected source revisions. Replacing a multi-order document recomputes the union of its previous and new referenced orders.
reviewAndReceiving.history: Customer edits are reasoned drafts against explicit original order revisions. New source files remain separate immutable documents.
reviewAndReceiving.portable: Deliver complete source/document/draft/revision/selection/transmission history; receive it into another workspace and preserve newer receiver work on compatible replay.
reviewAndReceiving.actualNativeInput: The sole original seven-source acquisition must supply all original ZIP members and exact DTD/license identity before the full publisher-sample receiving run.

license.specification: Copyright2000–2001 Fraunhofer IAO, Stuttgart; Universität Essen BLI. Original legal-status section permits use/copy/publication/distribution under its retained notice and implementation conditions.
license.originalStandard: Keep the original specification and DTD unchanged with attribution. Changes to a specification have their own required derived-work notice and must not be represented as the original openTRANS standard.
license.vendorSources: Retain current Unite pages and sample packages as original internal sources. Inspect their actual ZIP license/readme members before selecting any public redistribution.
license.authoredRules: This file is an authored implementation mapping of the cited factual interface requirements; complete original documents remain the source.
